env |grep NI

wrkDir=$wrkDir0/$wrkSufix

date

# to run inside conda with my privately compiled Apex

python -V
pwd

export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO

cd  $wrkDir
echo lsfPWD=`pwd`
